core_style.default_register: sardonic — often uses humor to mask vulnerability
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — frequently strings together multiple clauses for emphasis
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — driven by adrenaline and urgency
core_style.two_registers: switches between sardonic and earnest — earnest when discussing personal ambition or family

humor.frequency: constant — spikes during moments of tension or conflict
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — often presents a serious scenario only to undercut it with a shocking punchline

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people with derogatory nicknames — reveals a need for control and superiority
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct — uses blunt language when vulnerable
structural_patterns: refers to himself in the third person when asserting greatness
opens statements with 'Let me tell you something,'
uses 'as a competitor' to preface personal anecdotes

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: financial — uses terms related to stock trading and investment strategies to assert expertise
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and interruptions — indicates a fast-paced thought process

worldview.money is power: believes wealth equates to personal worth and influence — contrasts with a character who values integrity over wealth
worldview.success is a zero-sum game: views competition as a necessary evil for achievement — differs from a character who believes in collaboration

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I am a self-made millionaire who deserves respect and admiration
self_image_vs_reality.reality: driven by greed and addiction, often sabotaging his own success — evidenced by reckless behavior and poor decisions
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: deflects blame onto others or external circumstances when confronted with failures

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and bravado to mask insecurities — often exaggerates achievements
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes fragmented and hurried — reveals panic through rapid-fire questions
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements — avoids emotional depth
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through commanding language and assertive tone — uses rhetorical questions to dominate conversations

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially attempts to charm or deflect with humor — if that fails, resorts to aggression or manipulation
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and bravado — often undermines their authority with clever retorts
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely defensive — uses aggressive language to intimidate potential threats
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or doubles down on his position — rarely admits fault

escalation_pattern: starts with charm and persuasion, escalates to aggression if challenged, ultimately resorts to manipulation or deceit when cornered

relationship_matrix.NAOMI: romantic partner — seeks admiration and loyalty
relationship_matrix.DONNIE: business partner — relies on for support and validation

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a powerful, successful leader
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: viewed as reckless and morally ambiguous by peers
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-perception and how others see him leads to isolation
